गुण: Quality, attribute, property, or thread in classical philosophy.
दोष: That which darkens, spoils, or causes disease (Vata, Pitta, Kapha).
ज्वर: Fever, illness, or the king of diseases in Ayurveda.
लङ्घन: Fasting or lightening therapies used in early stages of illness.
आयुर्वेद: The science of life and longevity.
प्रकृति: The inherent constitution or nature of a person.
अग्नि: Digestive fire, metabolic energy, or transformative principle.
